additional_context: documents.html is in the current build through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml, and Composition is active in source/fhir.ini. The later Published FHIR-35830 decision explicitly removed Implementation Guide as an example in the same Documents paragraph and is already represented on the combined branch, reinforcing that the example should stay absent unless a new WG decision adds a concrete Composition example.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit.
